supporting_pages.title: Monitor Dataflow autoscaling \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: If the target CPU utilization is set too high, you might see a pattern where Dataflow scales down, the backlog starts to grow, and Dataflow scales up again to compensate, instead of converging on a stable number of workers.
Monitor autoscaling metrics The Dataflow service automatically chooses the number of worker instances required to run your autoscaling job.
You can view autoscaling monitoring charts for streaming jobs within the Dataflow monitoring interface.
